svg.title: One run of the research loop
svg.desc: Animated walk through the research graph: the planner fans out to parallel scouts, a join records their results in plan order, gap analysis fans out to deep dives, the synthesizer writes a report, the verifier checks it, and one verification round loops back before the run ends.
svg.text: One run of the research loop
Each box lights up while it runs. The dots are results passed from one step to the next.
Scout results, then each round of deep dives, in plan order

g.text: The planner splits the objective into questions, and a scout takes each one.
Results are recorded in plan order, then checked for gaps.
The most severe gaps get deep dives, which also run in parallel.
The synthesizer writes a report, and the verifier checks each claim.
Follow-ups get another round of research and a new report.
The run ends with its report, its verification, and its review reasons.
